Results: a sortable site table (Column, Template, Target, Differing, Exclusions) whose selection centres the column in the viewport, a Candidate windows table, Highlight in viewport, Copy TSV, Export TSV…, and Export JSON… (both re-run the CLI into the chosen destination).
